description.narrative: As outlined by the Strategic Plan 2021-25 of BDRCS, as a National Society, BDRCS has seen diverse transformative processes both internally (i.e., governance and management changes, new competencies requirement from the HR, new form of volunteerism, new form of service requirement etc.) and externally (i.e. frequent disasters, new form of crises, political changes and unrest, global economic changes etc.). Over the years, these changes have put pressure on the NS to adapt and to stay relevant to the emerging needs of the people. Following recent global crisis and emergencies including pandemic and escalation of armed hostilities in different countries and regions, the drive toward organizational transformation has been further reinforced in BDRCS. In connection to this, BDRCS has pinpointed its focused areas for National Society Development through developing a holistic NSD plan of action which includes the broader topics such as financial sustainability, human resource development, logistics development, branch development, information and Communication Technology, Youth and Volunteer Development and PMER development This project builds upon and or support the continuation of three initiatives under three different Grant Agreement Documents: 1) BDRCS Cash Readiness Programme (10/08/2021 to 31/03/2024) P8303 2) BDRCS CEA Institutionalization (01/10/2020 to 31/03/2024) P7962 3) NSD in Asia - Support to BDRCS (20/09/2021 to 31/03/2024) P8703
